exceptions.title: updates merged refs and event handlers when ref shape changes across rerenders
exceptions.reason: A part gives its ref callbacks one time, in `setup`, so their shape cannot change. React makes a new merged ref when the `ref` argument changes. A new test covers the handler half: a listener of the part that changes between two renders.

exceptions.reason: The warning is for a React component that is given as the `render` function. In Vue the `as` prop takes a component, and `#render` is a slot.

The cases test the lazy wrapper that the Flight client of React Server Components gives in place of a render element.

exceptions.title: throws error for invalid render element in development
exceptions.reason: The case tests `React.isValidElement` and `React.cloneElement`. No part clones a vnode.
The file tests that the result type follows `enabled`. The Vue composable has no `enabled` parameter: the template decides with `v-if`.
A server render runs in Node with no DOM. The cases are in the test file that the Node project runs, with the same titles.

The file is a React component that gives the list context to its children. A Vue part calls `useCompositeList` of `list/useCompositeList.ts` in `setup`, which holds the registry of this file, and renders its own element.

exceptions.title: syncs replacement refs without publishing an unchanged map
exceptions.reason: The case replaces the ref objects of a mounted list. A Vue part gives `elementsRef` and `labelsRef` one time, in `setup`. The new case `does not publish an unchanged map when a label changes` covers the half that applies.
React hides a mounted tree and detaches its refs when a component in it suspends again. A mounted Vue component cannot suspend again.

The file is a React component that renders the element of a part and gives it the composite context. A Vue part renders its own element and calls `useCompositeRoot` of `root/useCompositeRoot.ts` in `setup`, which holds the work of this file.

The file is a React component that renders the element of an item part and gives it the tab stop. A Vue part renders its own element and calls `useCompositeItem` of `item/useCompositeItem.ts` in `setup`, which holds the work of this file.

The file reads the `aria-label` of a React element that is given as `render`. In Vue the `as` prop takes a tag or a component with no props of its own, and `#render` is a slot, which is a function. A control reads its `aria-label` prop.
The cases test `resolveRenderedAriaLabel`, which reads a React element that is given as `render`.

The cases render `Select.Label`, `Combobox.Label` and `Field.Label`, which Vase UI does not have. Combobox comes last, so the row names its file. The cases "focuses the control of the provider when a label that is not native is clicked" and "focuses the control in the shadow root of the label when $name" test the focus part of this behavior with a fixture label and control. The check that the popup stays closed waits for Select and Combobox.

exceptions.title: preserves native label activation inside a shadow root
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Field.Root`, `Field.Label` and `Field.Control`, which Vase UI does not have. The case "gives a native label `for` with the id of the control and moves no focus itself" tests the part of this behavior that `useLabel` owns.

exceptions.title: focuses a control in the light DOM from a label in a shadow root
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Combobox.Root`, `Combobox.Label` and `Combobox.Trigger`, which Vase UI does not have. The case "focuses a control in the light DOM from a label in a shadow root" in the block "with a fixture label and control" tests the same behavior with no Combobox.

exceptions.title: focuses a control in an ancestor shadow root from a label in a nested shadow root
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Combobox.Root`, `Combobox.Label` and `Combobox.Trigger`, which Vase UI does not have. The case "focuses a control in an ancestor shadow root from a label in a nested shadow root" in the block "with a fixture label and control" tests the same behavior with no Combobox.

exceptions.title: does not throw when a label is clicked in a detached React root
exceptions.reason: The case renders `Field.Root`, `Field.Label`, `Select.Root` and `Select.Trigger`, which Vase UI does not have. The case "reports nothing and focuses nothing when a label in a container outside the document is clicked" tests the same behavior with a `<Teleport>` target that is outside the document.
No Base UI component imports the file. It is the module of the package entry `./internals/composite`, and Vase UI has no entry point for an internal module.
